proposal: Verified delivery of small software changes
repository_choice: new small application with real UI, HTTP API and local test database

models.name: Gemma 4
models.previous_candidate: CoreWeave FP4; pre-study readiness only; no scored outcomes
models.serving_label: Gemma as served by Crusoe at catalog-reported BF16

hypotheses.working_expectation: Supervision improves Gemma delivery enough to approach Terra reliability at substantially lower standardized model cost; this may be false.
secondary_comparisons: GLM supervising Gemma versus Terra alone
GLM supervising Gemma versus GLM alone
runtime and measured operator effort; human patch review only in optional extension

analysis_plan.interval_method: paired task-cluster percentile bootstrap, descriptive only; boundary and undefined draws explicitly reported
analysis_plan.precision_position: sample is for feasibility and estimates; not designed to establish the ten-point completion margin or joint economic target
analysis_plan.degenerate_intervals: report uninformative and show paired task outcomes; no precision certificate
analysis_plan.zero_acceptance_resamples: cost ratio undefined/unbounded; report proportion, never discard silently
analysis_plan.incomplete_planned_sample: report stage-specific feasibility estimates and missingness sensitivity
analysis_plan.capped_delivery_time: accepted submission time, otherwise registered T

stopping_rule.scope: entire agent/supervisor workflow including tools, waits, retries and worker handoffs
stopping_rule.account_exhaustion_action: stop new dispatch globally; preserve active attempts, incomplete blocks and missingness
stopping_rule.deadline_basis: fixed uniform practical cutoff selected before calibration; no pooled accepted-runtime median

calibration_timeout_review.action: pause before scoring; review scope/cutoff validity and preregister new calibration if redesigned; never extend selected arms or erase failures

criteria: native usage captured for at least 95 percent of completed calls with all missing calls listed
remaining tasks can be qualified without access to prior outcomes
optional human-review staffing does not gate core continuation

retry_control.name: public-selected Gemma three-run fixed-batch portfolio
retry_control.selection: first trusted-public-passing eligible candidate in preregistered order

pricing_rule.primary: frozen uncached API-equivalent input/output list prices
pricing_rule.formula: sum(inclusive_input/1e6 * list_input_price + billable_output/1e6 * list_output_price) across all components and paid retries
secondary: cache-aware API pricing with explicit write uncertainty
pricing_rule.missing_usage_policy: unresolved unless decision-valid bounds are available

excluded_families: Gemma and Gemini families (one exclusion group for independence)
applies_to: role/system/user prompts and worker handoff templates
construction_provenance.protocol_author_role: AI coordinator under human direction; not fixture-builder eligibility

artifact_author_records.class: generic role/task prompt skeleton, not an authoritative task-specific contract
artifact_author_records.author: AI coordinator under human direction
artifact_author_records.model: gpt-6.1-sol for current revision; earlier exact per-edit attribution not established
artifact_author_records.history: Git history preserves previous drafts; no independent review signoff yet

Gemini.decision: Treat Gemini and Gemma as the same exclusion group for study independence, without asserting identical weights/architecture. Includes fine-tuned/distilled derivatives where lineage is known.
Gemini.basis: Google describes Gemma 4 as built from Gemini 3 research and technology.

family_decisions.uncertain_lineage: resolve and record before appointment; uncertainty is not automatic eligibility

artifact_policies.fixture_contract_FAQ: authoritative task-specific baseline/reference/check/contract/FAQ construction uses eligible humans or models outside exclusion groups; product-owner requirements retained with human provenance
artifact_policies.role_prompts: GPT-family coordinator may draft role prompts and generic templates; record exact known model/harness, source hashes and substantive edits; independent content/neutrality review outside exclusion groups required before freeze
artifact_policies.corpus: coordinator may propose sources and mechanically package approved inputs; independent content approval outside exclusion groups required
artifact_policies.historical_drafts: preserve known provenance; unavailable historical model IDs/settings explicitly unknown, never inferred from thread nickname
artifact_policies.all_artifacts: record authors/contributors, exact known models/families/providers/harness/settings or unknown, timestamps, source lineage, hashes, reviewer identity and independent signoff

checks.public_suite: representative examples and baseline regressions; not exhaustive final acceptance
checks.sealed_suite: new cases and combinations of disclosed requirements
checks.ui_locator_policy: accessible roles/names/labels; justified preregistered exceptions only

primary_endpoint: first complete-agent/supervisor final return, uniform deadline, or recorded external interruption
primary_acceptance_rule: Timely final submission passes all applicable frozen independent machine behavior, UI/API/database, ownership, regression, build, typecheck, lint, scope and integrity checks; human review is an optional extension
public_report: Observed results and hypothetical pricing remain separate

mcp_setup.browser_checks: public Playwright via shell; evaluator runs separately

documentation_corpus.versions_derived_from: benchmark lockfile and runtime versions after baseline selection
documentation_corpus.context_serve_policy: prefetch approved packages; serve --libs with exact name@version entries; verify registry search/download tools hidden
documentation_corpus.retrieval_usage_recorded_as: local lexical retrieval latency and preparation overhead; no extra model
coverage_gaps: Vite/Hono and associated adapter docs not yet built/reviewed
documentation_corpus.context_storage_isolation: dedicated container or OS identity with approved ~/.context/packages; no undocumented directory override
documentation_corpus.existing_local_server_check: Context startup/catalog/Next retrieval passed; new Vite/Hono corpus not built
documentation_corpus.coordinator_role: OpenAI GPT-family coordinator may propose sources and run approved mechanical packaging; cannot independently sign content suitability
documentation_corpus.independent_reviewer_eligibility: independent human or recorded model outside subject families; human recruitment not required

application_preparation.architecture: Vite React SPA plus separate Hono Node HTTP API; SQLite; Better Auth server sessions; same-origin proxy/static serving

harness_decision.reason: reduce harness confounding and duplicate adapter work

launch_blockers.detail: independent corpus qualification by eligible human or model outside subject families; source selection and omissions reviewed
appoint eligible baseline/reference/check builders and qualifiers outside subject families
completion-only bill verified, including all instrumented adapter calls; native OpenCode split documented as unsuitable for billing; raw gateway usage capture required
qualify full study Context/broker path and persistent raw provider usage capture; apply and qualify all registered provider pins including Gemma BF16
qualify baseline, calibration tasks, source corpus, evaluator and isolated DB authorization
record and independently approve authoritative role prompts, worker handoff templates, task contracts and frozen FAQ under artifact-specific provenance rules
qualify two equal isolated lanes and rate-limit behavior, or explicitly amend to sequential

pre_recruitment_work.allowed: core setup, calibration and scoring once non-human-review registration gates pass

human_review.prompt: Would I merge this patch for the declared contract?
human_review.time_recording: active inspection and reproduction until verdict; queues and familiarization separate
human_review.critical_defects: extension records reproduced defects and reviewed verdicts separately; preserve original core machine result

capacity_plan.basis: planning assumptions, not measurements; no duplicate review charge for portfolio reuse

human_review.recruitment_status: owner_has_no_candidates; reviewer brief prepared; no outreach sent
human_review.scope: frozen endpoint patches; sampling and blinding preregistered before extension
human_review.repair_work: separate repair extension; never silently repair original endpoints
human_review.missing_review: not_measured; not zero and not a core acceptance failure

acceptance_reporting.human_merge_readiness: unverified unless optional review extension performed
acceptance_reporting.human_review_effort: not measured unless optional review extension performed
acceptance_reporting.review_findings: published separately against original frozen endpoints; reproduced evaluator defects trigger the uniform correction protocol

provider_qualification.precision_choice: Prefer tested ZDR BF16 Gemma candidate over FP4 before calibration; no model ID substitution
provider_qualification.if_BF16_unavailable: pause; register/requalify explicit alternative (FP8 preferred, FP4 must be labeled as served at FP4); do not pool configurations

glm_relace_fp4.interpretation: completion-only reproduces this bill exactly; not evidence that reasoning is a subset of completion or of physically separate chargeable tokens
glm_relace_fp4.native_OpenCode_output_caveat: OpenCode subtracts reasoning and clamps output at zero; when reasoning exceeds completion, output+reasoning overcounts billed output. Never reconstruct billed output from that split.
glm_relace_fp4.authoritative_billing_source: captured raw gateway/provider usage.completion_tokens, cross-checked against provider cost; preserve OpenCode native fields separately

execution_schedule.reserve: remaining CPU/memory for controller and separately limited evaluator; no competing interactive build jobs
execution_schedule.qualification: replay same generic/public mechanical commands alone and with both lanes loaded; median duration inflation <=10%, no OOM/throttling/unaccounted swap or transport rate-limit drift; same limits in sequential qualification
execution_schedule.if_qualification_fails: amend to sequential before calibration; preserve failed qualification; no silent mixed scheduling
execution_schedule.assignment: seeded balanced lane and time-block assignment across arms/tasks; preserve paired blocks; do not run all of one model first
execution_schedule.portfolio: physical collection may overlap; report registered sequential retry-policy opportunity as sum of candidate durations, not minimum parallel latency
execution_schedule.provider_drift_checks: verify catalog revision/tag/quantization before each dispatch and generation resolution after each call; stop new dispatch on drift and record affected runs; resume as separately registered cohort, never pool silently
execution_schedule.opaque_provider_drift_limit: unchanged public IDs cannot prove immutable hidden serving weights/settings

collection_forecast.excludes: fixture/reference/negative-control/corpus construction, independent qualification, outages, provider requalification and optional human review
collection_forecast.reforecast: after first technical block and calibration using actual endpoint runtimes, timeout rates and setup/evaluation overhead; preserve forecast history; no outcome-based sample changes
